(Moon, Pennsylvania) | college = * [[Pittsburgh Panthers men's basketball|Pittsburgh]] (2014–2017) * [[North Carolina Tar Heels men's basketball|North Carolina]] (2017–2019) | draft_year = | draft_round = | draft_pick = | draft_team = | career_start = | years1 = | team1 = | highlights = *First-team All-[[Atlantic Coast Conference|ACC]] (2019) | medaltemplates = }} '''Cameron Jordan Johnson''' (born March 3, 1996) is an American [[basketball]] player. He played college basketball for the [[North Carolina Tar Heels men's basketball|North Carolina Tar Heels]]. ==High school career== As a junior in high school, Johnson was a 6-foot-2 point guard before having a growth spurt. He graduated from [[Our Lady of the Sacred Heart High School (Coraopolis)|Our Lady of the Sacred Heart]].{{cite news |last1=Meyer |first1=Craig |title=Cameron Johnson finds a home at North Carolina |url=http://www.post-gazette.com/sports/Pitt/2018/04/04/cameron-johnson-north-carolina-pitt-transfer-acc/stories/201804060006 |accessdate=May 31, 2018 |work=[[Pittsburgh Post-Gazette]] |date=April 4, 2018}} As a senior at Sacred Heart, Johnson averaged 27.8 points, eight rebounds and five assists per game. He finished his career with 1,175 points. He signed with [[Pittsburgh Panthers men's basketball|Pittsburgh]] in April 2014.{{cite news |last1=Gorman |first1=Kevin |title=OLSH guard Johnson signs with Pitt; Rohrssen officially leaving for UK |url=http://triblive.com/sports/hssports/highschoolrecruiting/5983744-74/johnson-pitt-senior |accessdate=June 1, 2018 |work=TribLive |date=April 21, 2014}} ==College career== ===Pittsburgh=== Johnson was forced to redshirt his freshman year due to missing much of the season with an injury.{{cite news |last1=Carter |first1=Andrew |title=Cameron Johnson signs UNC scholarship |url=http://www.newsobserver.com/sports/college/acc/unc/unc-now/article156596029.html |accessdate=June 1, 2018 |work=[[The News & Observer]] |date=June 16, 2017}} As a redshirt sophomore at Pitt, Johnson averaged 11.9 points per game and hit 41.5% of his three point attempts. Johnson graduated from [[Pittsburgh Panthers men's basketball|Pittsburgh]] with a degree in communications in three years. He took advantage of the graduate transfer rule and moved to North Carolina without sitting out a year. The University of Pittsburgh initially refused to allow his release to their in-conference rival Tar Heels but eventually relented.{{cite news |last1=Marks |first1=Brendan |title=Forward finally joins North Carolina after transfer challenge |url=https://www.si.com/college-basketball/2017/06/16/cameron-johnson-north-carolina-transfer |accessdate=May 31, 2018 |work=[[Sports Illustrated]] |date=June 16, 2017}} He cited uncertainty in coaching and a losing record as factors in his decision to transfer. ===North Carolina=== On November 15, 2017, five days after his team’s season opener, Johnson had surgery to fix a torn meniscus. Johnson ended up sitting out ten games. Although hindered by a knee injury, Johnson finished third on the team in scoring with 12.4 points per game as well as grabbing 4.7 rebounds per game in his redshirt junior season. Johnson scored a career-high 32 points against [[Clemson Tigers men's basketball|Clemson]]. After the season, Johnson underwent an arthroscopic hip procedure and announced his intention to return to North Carolina for his senior season.{{cite news |last1=Alexander |first1=Jonathan
